boundaries: Immutable. A digest is required; a tag is a label for humans.
Content-addressed. Bytes are verified before extraction, not after.
Referenced by name in the manifest, resolved at launch, never written to logs or bundles.
May read declared capabilities only. A benchmark-name branch here is a defect.
confidence: None — no bundle has been built, uploaded or launched under this schema yet.
hypothesis: Every supported task runtime can be launched, verified and restarted through one capability-dispatched path, with no benchmark-name conditionals in generic code.
legend: runtime / process boundary — one thing that can crash on its own
trust boundary — crossing it changes who may read the data
sealed or secret region — never reaches a policy-visible observation
control or data flow in the direction of the arrow
a durable identifier: run, episode, checkpoint, candidate or digest
state that is written to durable storage and survives a restart

│ repository · full commit sha   │                ║ image reference                ║
│ build recipe digest            │                ║ digest sha256:…                ║
│ builder identity               │   push image   ║ platforms: amd64, arm64        ║ bind
│ excludes .git, creds, caches,  │───────────────▶║                                ║─────▶

│                                │                ║                                ║      │ bundleId · revision              │
└────────────────────────────────┘                ╚════════════════════════════════╝      │ image{reference, digest}         │
                 │                                                                        │ source{uri, digest, mediaType}   │
                 │                                                                        │ contracts{taskFamily,            │
                 │                                ╔═══════ S3 SOURCE BUNDLE ═══════╗      │   capabilities, optimizer}       │
                 │                                ║ content-addressed key          ║      │ runtime{command, ports,          │
                 │                                ║ digest sha256:…                ║      │   healthcheck, timeout}          │
                 │                   upload src   ║ media type + size bytes        ║ bind │ security · provenance · license  │
                 └───────────────────────────────▶║                                ║─────▶│ manifest digest sha256:…         │
                                                  ║ digest computed before upload  ║      │                                  │
                                                  ║                                ║      └──────────────────────────────────┘
                                                  ╚════════════════════════════════╝


Generic orchestration dispatches on declared capabilities — never on a benchmark name.
A mismatch is a refusal to launch, never a pin quietly rewritten to match a local tag.
panels.caption: The manifest is the only place the image digest, the source digest, the task contract and the build revision meet. Everything downstream cites its digest.
notes: Mutable tags are display-only; an immutable registry digest is required.
Credentials never enter the source bundle or the manifest — only secret references, resolved at launch and never logged.

ONE DOWNLOADER / LAUNCHER — the same eleven steps for HealthBench, Craftax, EssayBench and DungeonGrid


┌── 1–4  RESOLVE + VERIFY ───┐              ┌── 5–6  IMAGE + PREFLIGHT ──┐              ┌─── 7–9  START + RECORD ────┐
│ resolve manifest           │              │ pull exact image digest    │              │ isolated run root          │
│ check authorization        │              │ validate platform          │              │ wait on declared health    │
│ download / cache source    │   verified   │ validate resources, ports  │   admitted   │ and capability contract    │
│ verify digest              │─────────────▶│ validate network policy    │─────────────▶│ record container id, ports │
│ safe extract:              │              │ resolve secret references  │              │ image / source / manifest  │
│   no traversal,            │              │   (never logged)           │              │ digests, log paths         │
│   no symlink escape        │              │                            │              │                            │
└────────────────────────────┘              └────────────────────────────┘              └────────────────────────────┘
                                                           │
                                                           │
                                                           ▼
┌────── CONFORMANCE SUITE ───────┐            ┌── 10–11  STOP + RESTART ───┐        ┌────── PROVENANCE RECORD § ───────┐
│ 403 · 404 · timeout · cut body │            │ stop descendants           │        │ every run cites the manifest     │
│ arch mismatch · no capability  │            │ clean temporary state      │        │ digest it actually launched      │
│ cache corruption · concurrent  │◀───────────│ restart from same bundle   │───────▶│ round-trips back to the build    │

Refuse to launch when the image, source, architecture, task contract or optimizer capability is unavailable.

notes: Restart uses the same immutable bundle, so a restarted container is the same container by construction rather than by convention.
